analysis_md:
由 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2+z^2=\pi^2\\z^2=3x^2+3y^2\end{cases}$，则 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2=(\frac{\pi}{2})^2\\z=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\pi\end{cases}$，于是 $\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{6}\\0\leq r\leq\pi\end{cases}$

原式 $=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}d\varphi\int_0^\pi\sin(r^3)\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr=\frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot(1-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})\cdot\int_0^\pi\sin(r^3)\,dr^3$

$=\frac{2-\sqrt{3}}{3}\pi\cdot(-\cos r^3)\big|_0^\pi=\frac{(2-\sqrt{3})\pi(1-\cos\pi^3)}{3}$。
